text.description_html:
Pemko 164M, 80" Threshold-Sill Residential Door Threshold

Pemko's Threshold-Sill thresholds are designed specifically for the pre-hung door market. These 80 inch long thresholds are made from non-rusting extruded aluminum and are classified as gasket material for use on listed steel frames and fire doors rated up to and including 3 hours. Fabrication includes 3 nail holes at each end and one center screw.

Field sizable, non-handed for outswing doors. Powder coated finish. Packaged with installation screws.

Specifications for the Pemko 164M Door Threshold:

  • Length: 80"
  • Height: 1-3/16"
  • Width: 6-1/2"
  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Dark Bronze Anodized Aluminum
  • Meets requirements of UL10B and UL10C

This is a special order item. NOT Returnable.
